device_path.description: Path of the dev filesystem device to monitor

timeout_ms.description: Number of milliseconds gestures must be performed within to be registered

screen_width.description: Width of the screen area for edge-based gestures. Use 'auto' for dynamic detection

screen_height.description: Height of the screen area for edge-based gestures. Use 'auto' for dynamic detection

orientation.description: Number of 90-degree rotations to translate gestures by (0-3)

degrees_of_leniency.description: Number of degrees offset each 45-degree interval may still be recognized within (max 45)

distance_threshold.description: Threshold in libinput units after which a gesture registers in release mode

distance_threshold_pressed.description: Threshold in libinput units after which a gesture registers when fingers are not lifted

verbose.description: Enable verbose mode which prints debugging messages

gestures.description: List of gesture bindings. Each item is a map with nfingers, gesture, edge, distance, actmode, command fields.
